name: Banh duc hen
summary: Bánh đúc hến is soft bánh đúc with stir-fried clams. Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch calls it a plain central plate and says people eat it in the afternoon or the evening. A Vinh street was not printed.
origin: Nghệ An, on the Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch specialty page. Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch does not name a commune.
texture: Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch says the bánh đúc is soft.
howToEat: Eat it in the afternoon or the evening, as Trung tâm Thông tin du lịch says. It describes soft bánh đúc and fragrant stir-fried clams, and it does not give a recipe. A price is Check on arrival.
where: A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
